name: activate_cardiac_protocol
description: Activate the acute cardiac emergency protocol (Code STEMI or cardiac alert) for time-critical cardiac intervention

cath_lab_activation.description: Whether cardiac catheterization lab needs activation

when_to_use: ECG showing ST-elevation consistent with STEMI
Cardiac arrest with shockable rhythm requiring emergent intervention
Acute coronary syndrome with hemodynamic instability
New-onset heart failure with pulmonary edema requiring urgent intervention
Sustained ventricular tachycardia unresponsive to initial treatment

examples.query: ECG shows anterolateral ST elevation, patient has crushing chest pain since 45 minutes ago
Patient in cardiac arrest, VF on monitor, CPR in progress
